title: Lunar Dream Weaver
description: A large grey moon face with glowing yellow eyes and intricate green spiral patterns dominates the left side against a swirling pink and blue vortex. On the right, an elderly couple sits on a living room couch watching the scene, while a flowing red ribbon filled with smaller faces and figures streams from the moon into the room.
prompt: Surreal psychedelic scene featuring a giant grey moon with a human face, glowing yellow eyes, and intricate green spiral patterns set against a swirling pink and blue vortex background. A flowing red fabric ribbon filled with multiple faces and figures streams from the moon into a cozy living room where an elderly couple sits on a couch watching a lamp-lit scene with two large stylized female faces on the wall.
